description.value: Romeo's is a multi-location Vancouver Island pizza and Italian restaurant chain that has operated in this Westshore Town Centre location since 1982. The Langford restaurant offers dine-in with a patio, plus delivery and takeout across a broad menu of pizzas, pastas, burgers, and mains. It is part of a four-location family operation serving Vancouver Island since 1974, making it a reliable and familiar stop for cyclists riding through the Westshore corridor.
